name: Dorna Gralune
keeps: the oath he is named for breaking
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Refused to plead, so there was no conviction and no forfeiture.
text: Dorna gralune of the long gallery, carries between for the 4th tranche, doors 29 to 38. Keeps the oath he is named for breaking. Reads Giles Corey.
